description.text: Core courses Survey of the Earth, Natural Geography, Surveying and Cartography, Geological Geomorphology, Human Geography, Meteorology and Climatology, Soil Geography, Plant Geography, Hydrographic Geography, Chinese Physical Geography, Physical Geography of World, China's Economic Geography, Economic Geography, World Economic Geography, Change of Global Environment, Field Work, Teaching Practice, Educational Practice, and Graduation Thesis Writing and Graduation Projects. Objective This objective is to train students to be able to work as teachers teaching geography in institutions of higher and intermediate learning, or as high-quality inter-disciplinary or applied-oriented personnel to do research related to teaching or other educational work. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.

duration.text: The Horticulture at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
